items.prompt: Design a complete, premium, original logo for a French watchmaking brand, as a top branding agency would deliver it (flat logo artwork only, not a mockup). Brand name: "ARVEN". Trade line: "HORLOGERIE". Slogan: "Le temps, bien porté." Concept: an elegant emblem inspired by a chronograph bezel — a thin precise circle with fine minute ticks, enclosing a refined monogram letter A whose crossbar reads like a watch hand; timeless, Swiss-style precision, luxury but understated. Below the emblem, the name ARVEN in wide, perfectly spaced high-contrast serif capitals; beneath it, smaller, the trade line HORLOGERIE in spaced sans-serif capitals; and at the bottom, smallest, the slogan Le temps, bien porté. in an italic serif. Colors: deep near-black #111214 for the name and emblem, cognac #A0612B as the single accent (the monogram hand and a thin line), on a plain ivory #F3EFE7 background. Spell every word EXACTLY, with the accent on é; no other words, no fake letters, no numbers other than the bezel ticks. Centered composition, generous margins, crisp vector-like edges, no gradients, no 3D, no shadow, no texture.
